class: A domain function that raises a typed exception for an input shape the user can legitimately build (legs on two expiries) with no route-level mapping to a catalogue user-facing error returns a bare HTTP 500 instead of a message the user can act on.
mechanism: POST /api/strategies/outcome calls the at-expiry metrics, which raise ofo.engine.metrics.MultiExpiryError when legs are on more than one expiry; the route does not catch it.

first_seen.where: ofo_dev API log, a draft holding 19 Oct and 27 Oct legs
first_seen.evidence: 3 occurrences in the API log: ofo.engine.metrics.MultiExpiryError: exact at-expiry metrics need every leg on one expiry, returned as a bare 500 from POST /api/strategies/outcome

fix: Not fixed (minor). Class fix: map MultiExpiryError (and any typed domain error the route can raise) to a catalogue error with a user-facing message at the route layer, with a test that posts a two-expiry draft and asserts the exact status and message.

detection.note: Minor severity. Unmeasured: other routes that call engine functions raising typed errors without a mapping.

occurrences.where: POST /api/strategies/outcome, draft with 19 Oct and 27 Oct legs
